message: CareNav shows an inline refill tracker pinned to the sidebar - keeps the user oriented during the entire medication flow. We should test something similar against the current step navigation.
P12 usability session - user said "I keep losing my place when I switch between the medication list and the pickup options". This directly maps to the step navigation gap we identified.

Pulling together Anita's CareNav note (inline refill tracker) and P12 feedback - WellSync uses contextual help tooltips in their messaging flow too. Proposing sticky progress bar for this view plus tooltip overlays.
MyHealthHub has a persistent breadcrumb nav in their SSO login flow that never disappears - keeps users oriented even during redirects. We should benchmark against that for 11:01.
Testing linear stepper variant here - three columns, no sidebar. Feels cleaner but might lose context at narrow viewports.
Accordion version feels more natural for mobile. Collapse completed steps. Still needs accessibility pass.
Tab group approach - each step is a tab. Simple but the tab overflow on mobile is a problem.
Title typography here is inconsistent with the rest of the system.
Spacing between toggle options feels tight on narrow screens.
Bottom tab icons need to be 24px not 20px per the design system.
Avatar stack truncation at 5+ looks awkward. Try a +N counter.
Revenue chart needs a tooltip on hover for the data points.
Records table sorting should default to most recent first.
Badge counter overflows at 999+. Need truncation logic.
The old card layout at 10:05 should just be deleted - it's confusing having it next to the new flow.
This whole file is archived - moving discussions to the new token library.
